entries.title: A thorough search follows each quick one
entries.body: When you type a new quick search in an article of your own, the app now starts a thorough search by meaning for you, once the quick answer has finished and stayed unchanged for two seconds. The quick results stay on screen while it runs, and the thorough answer then takes their place in the same position, keeping the colour and tick. Press Enter or Find to skip the wait.

entries.title: Paragraph chat can sit beside its paragraph
entries.body: On your own articles, a chat about a paragraph now appears as a card beside that paragraph. You can fold the card shut, and it scrolls with the article. This happens only when the notes column is showing, the paragraph is open and there is room; otherwise the chat stays where it was.

entries.title: Find more works from the command bar
entries.body: On an article of your own, you can type Find more into the command bar to add to its Glossary or its Quotes. The action is offered only when that list can be added to. Choosing it opens the panel, which starts the search itself unless one is already running.

entries.title: The command bar knows more names per mode
entries.body: Typing table of contents, headings, sections or chapters finds Structure; jargon, vocabulary or dictionary finds Glossary; locate, ctrl f or keyword finds Search. Every mode has more nicknames like these, and the Run again actions named after a mode accept them too.

entries.title: Documents added by address share the upload limit
entries.body: A document you add by its address may be as large as one you upload; the limit for an address used to be lower. If a document is still too large, the message now says so, and it no longer offers a Retry that would fail again.

entries.title: The headings trail hides when it is redundant
entries.body: If you have the Experimental features switch on in your profile, the trail of headings above the article is no longer shown in Structure, or while the notes column is on screen. Both already show where you are in the piece.

entries.title: A lone question note no longer repeats itself
entries.body: Opening a question note that stood alone in the notes column repeated its heading and its passage. It no longer does.
